Kuwait
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Kuwait City, Kuwait.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Sarajevo):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the State of Kuwait are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
